name: Treasured Flower
description:
A wild flower that a Hilichurl Rogue treasured, bereft of any special qualities.
Flowers can be used as gifts or offerings to express one's feelings in many cultures.
fullDescription: A wild flower that a Hilichurl Rogue treasured, bereft of any special qualities.\nFlowers can be used as gifts or offerings to express one's feelings in many cultures.\nThough no longer bound by any cultural framework, perhaps that meaning still holds true.
